
```{r expected-response}
# choose response
# simulate business and school closures but with schools open
# NOTE: THIS IS AN EXAMPLE, MODIFY THIS CODE TO RUN RESULTS
openness_coef <- daedalus.data::closure_strategy_data$elimination
i_EDUCATION_SECTOR <- 41L
openness_coef[i_EDUCATION_SECTOR] <- 1.0
```

```{r response-object}
# NOTE: RESPONSE START AND END TIMES
response_start <- 45 # this can change based on participants' choice
response_duration <- 90 # this should be fixed for Step 3

# first do a null response
response_none <- daedalus_timed_npi(
 response_start, response_start + response_duration,
 list(rep(1.0, 45L)), country 
)

# make response option
response_main <- daedalus_timed_npi(
  response_start, response_start + response_duration,
  list(openness_coef),
  country
)
```
